The p rimal- d ual h ybrid g radient (PDHG) method is one of the most popular algorithms for solving saddle point problems. arxiv-2506-12704.title: Flexible Realignment of Language Models
arxiv-2506-12704.creator: Wenhong Zhu, Ruobing Xie, Weinan Zhang, Rui Wang
arxiv-2506-12704.description: Abstract Realignment becomes necessary when a language model (LM) fails to meet expected performance. We propose a flexible realignment framework that supports quantitative control of alignment degree during training and inference. This framework incorporates Training-time Realignment (TrRa) , which efficiently realigns the reference model by leveraging the controllable fusion of logits from both the reference and already aligned models.

pmc-10657122.title: ACT001 Alleviates chronic kidney injury induced by a high-fat diet in mice through the GPR43/AMPK pathway
pmc-10657122.creator: Yibing Zhou, Ze Chen, Hui Zhou, Bin Niu, Jing Liu, Yinglun Li, Yuqiang Mi, Ping Li
pmc-10657122.description: BackgroundRoughly 10 -15% of global populace suffer from Chronic Kidney Disease(CKD). A major secondary disease that can progress to end-stage renal disease (ESRD) is obesity-associated kidney disease (ORG). Although clinical management strategies are currently available, morbidity and mortality rates are increasing. Thus, new solutions are needed. Intestinal permeability, systemic inflammation, and aberrant intestinal metabolites have all been linked to ORG.

pmc-11406798.creator: Qiuting Fei, Huan Zhao, Yong Wang, Yu Chen

pmc-12691441.title: Early-Life Socialization Enhances Social Competence and Alters Affiliative Preference in Piglets
pmc-12691441.creator: Lu Luo, Zhengyu Li, J Elizabeth Bolhuis, Yuyan Wang, Dongsheng Wu, Yansen Li, Chunmei Li, Emma Fàbrega i Romans
pmc-12691441.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryEarly-life socialization of piglets—achieved by allowing interaction with neighboring litters before weaning—is an effective and low-cost strategy to improve pig welfare. While instances of aggression were rare overall, our study found that this practice significantly reduced the proportion of pigs exhibiting such behavior towards unfamiliar conspecifics later in life, suggesting it enhances social competence and lowers the threshold for threat perception.

Participants underwent a 6-week interdisciplinary pain management program and completed measures of sleep-related function and physical function, including objective measures of treadmill, lift, and carry battery. Urine samples were collected at baseline and 6 weeks.

pmc-13680477.title: Resolving short-term meteorological variability amplifies projected glacier loss and sea-level rise
pmc-13680477.creator: Lander Van Tricht, Matthias Huss, Harry Zekollari, Rodrigo Aguayo, Janosch Beer, Marit van Tiel, Alexandra von der Esch, Daniel Farinotti
pmc-13680477.description: Global glacier models typically rely on temperature-index mass balance calculations forced with aggregated meteorological data, limiting their ability to resolve short-term variability. Here, we develop a daily-resolution version of the Global Glacier Evolution Model (GloGEM), which we apply globally and compare against the monthly configuration.

pmc-13702797.title: Wildlife trade as a driver of pandemic emergence: a post-COVID alliance’s legacy of response
pmc-13702797.creator: Jamie K Reaser, Ann-Kristen Konzak, Johannes Keil, Beate Henrichfreise, Michael Nagel
pmc-13702797.description: Human health is inextricably linked to the health of wildlife populations and ecological systems. One Health science offers a multi-faceted approach to pandemic prevention, holistically investigating the interrelatedness of environmental, animal, and human health. Wildlife trade is a vital context for this work; zoonotic disease transmission along the wildlife trade pathway has had devastating social, cultural, and economic consequences.
